The latest test results show normal readings for the antibody panel. Given your history of fever, itchy rash, and joint pain developing specifically after starting antibiotics, combined with the absence of anaphylaxis or severe joint inflammation, this clinical picture strongly suggests a drug eruption, likely a morbilliform rash. Do you have any specific allergies to penicillin or cephalosporins?
